title: Collect skills with missing icon/description data
description:
When DeathReplay captures HIT events, some abilities arrive without an iconNum (and likely without tooltip/description metadata available to the addon). These abilities currently render with no icon in the timeline/overview.

Observed examples (from Plana SavedVariables, Dragonwake death):
- Lotsa Choppin (abilityId=3162) — 3 crit hits (700/746/739), no iconNum
- Tooth of Tzeentch (abilityId=3787) — 1 hit (32), no iconNum
- Tzeentch's Cry — also seen without iconNum

These are likely abilities that the WAR API's GetAbilityIcon/related calls return 0/nil for, so they're omitted at capture time in DeathReplay.lua.

Goal: build a collection mechanism so we accumulate a list of abilityIds (with their names) that lack icon data. Later this list can be filled in via the Warbuilder static database integration (see prior work) or manual curation.

Suggested approach:
- At capture time, when iconNum is missing/0, append { abilityId, ability } to a SavedVariables side-table (e.g. DeathReplay_SavedVariables.missingIconAbilities = { [abilityId] = name, ... }) — deduped by id.
- No UI needed for now; just persistent collection so the data is ready when we get around to filling icon/description mappings.
- Later: feed this list into Warbuilder lookup; for ones Warbuilder also lacks, this becomes the to-curate list.
notes:
Add: Shock VII — has tooltip/description available but no icon resolved at capture time. Suggests the missing-icon collection should be separate from missing-description; some abilities may need only one of the two filled in. Consider tracking flags per id: { hasIcon, hasDescription }.
Add: Pilfer VI — same pattern as Shock VII: description available, no icon resolved at capture time. Reinforces need for per-ability { hasIcon, hasDescription } flags.
Add: Tooth of Tzeentch (captured abilityId=3787) — no icon AND no description resolved at capture time. Per investigation: 3787 is the tick ID; Warbuilder stores cast ID 8317 (Icon=005175). Confirms the tick→cast ID mismatch pattern (same root cause as Lotsa Choppin 3162→1747). hasIcon=false, hasDescription=false.
Add: Blade Spin (captured abilityId=35756) — no icon, no description resolved at capture time. Confirmed in Plana SavedVariables (3 hits in one death event: 414 crit, 198, plus one more). hasIcon=false, hasDescription=false. High abilityId (35756) suggests it's outside the typical career-line range Warbuilder covers — possibly an item proc, weapon enchant, or NPC ability. Worth checking whether Warbuilder has it at all.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text:
## Investigation: coverage of the 6 known missing abilities

Searched Warbuilder, all sibling addons, and the WAR addon API surface.

### Resolution coverage table

| Ability | Captured ID | Warbuilder cast ID | Icon | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lotsa Choppin | 3162 (tick) | 1747 | 002635 | Warbuilder Choppa.lua:36 |
| Tooth of Tzeentch | 3787 (tick) | 8317 | 005175 | Warbuilder Chosen.lua:7 |
| Tzeentch's Cry | unknown | 8568 | 005160 | Warbuilder Zealot.lua:10 |
| Blade Spin | 35756 (tick) | 35758 | 011052 | Warbuilder WichElf.lua:9 (off-by-2 tick→cast) |
| Shock VII | n/a | — | — | NOT in any addon (renown) |
| Pilfer VI | n/a | — | — | NOT in any addon (renown) |

4 of 6 resolvable from Warbuilder by cast ID. All 4 are tick→cast mismatches with varying offsets (no arithmetic shortcut). Renown abilities (Shock, Pilfer) are absent from every addon database — `advancedrenowntrainer` has the table but those entries are commented out.

### Key API findings

- `GetAbilityData(id)` only covers the local player's spellbook — useless for foreign casters' abilities.
- `Player.GetAbilityData(id)` same scope.
- `Tooltips.CreateAbilityTooltip(abilityData, ...)` renders into the global tooltip but does NOT expose description text as data — there is no `GetAbilityTooltip(id) -> string` API. **Description strings are not retrievable for non-spellbook abilities.**
- Live effect structs from `SystemData.Events.PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED` carry `{ abilityId, name, iconNum, effectText }` — this is the canonical source for foreign auras (Aura and BuffHead use this exclusively).
- Obsidian's Castbar.lua:441 has an "item proc" branch (`abilityData.id == 0` → `CacheItemIcons(abilityId)`). High IDs like Blade Spin 35756 may hit this path.

### Warbuilder integration recipe

Walk `Warbuilder.Career[1..24]` once at init to build a flat `byCastId[id] = {Icon, Name, Career, Path, Type, BuffType, MinLevel}` map. Schema documented in `Warbuilder/Source/Warbuilder.lua` and `Warbuilder/Definitions/*.lua`. Add Warbuilder as an optional dependency in `.mod`. **But:** captured tick IDs won't match — DeathReplay still needs its existing name→castId mapping to bridge tick→cast first.

### No tick→cast resolver exists in the ecosystem

Zero addons handle the tick-id vs cast-id mismatch. DeathReplay.lua:95-105 already documents the problem (Touch of Palsy cast=8338, tick=3400). The current name-keyed cache from PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED is the correct architecture.

### Recommendation for this ticket (collection mechanism)

Build the SavedVariables side-table with per-ability flags as suggested in the latest notes:

```lua
DeathReplay_SavedVariables.missingAbilityMeta = {
  [abilityId] = { name=<wstring>, hasIcon=<bool>, hasDescription=<bool>, firstSeen=<ts> }
}
```

Capture point: in the HIT/BUFF_GAIN handlers, when iconNum is 0/nil OR description lookup returns nothing, upsert into the table. Keep it deduped by id and bounded (e.g. cap at 500 entries). No UI needed — purely data accumulation for later curation against Warbuilder + manual fill-in for renown skills.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text:
## Discovery on re-read: most of option 2 already shipped

Closer read of DeathReplay.lua shows the Warbuilder integration is mostly built already:

- `.mod:42` already declares Warbuilder as `optional="false" forceEnable="true"` (hard dep, with forced enable).
- `staticAbilityDB[id]` is populated at init by `buildStaticAbilityDB()` walking `Warbuilder.Career[]` (lines 170-213, called at line 505).
- `resolveIconForAbility` consults the static DB after the runtime caches (lines 248-253).
- Public `DeathReplay.GetAbilityMeta(id)` exposes `{icon, type, buffType, line}` to GUI/Indicator (line 219).

What's NOT yet implemented and is the actual missing piece: **name-keyed mirror of the Warbuilder DB**, so tick-id captures (3162, 3787, 35756, etc.) can bridge to the cast entry via wstring name. Currently the static lookup only checks `staticAbilityDB[abilityID]` which misses every DoT tick.

Plan:
1. Add `staticAbilityDBByName = {}` alongside `staticAbilityDB`.
2. In `buildStaticAbilityDB`, after inserting by ID, call `GetAbilityName(e.ID)`. If non-empty, mirror `staticAbilityDBByName[name] = e.Icon`.
3. In `resolveIconForAbility`, add a final fallback: `staticAbilityDBByName[abilityName]`.

Also split off ticket DeathReplay-9sd for weapon-proc abilities (Shock VII, Pilfer VI) — those are item-applied damage, not career skills, and need a different resolution strategy (likely `CacheItemIcons`-style).

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text:
## Implementation landed in two commits

**Commit 9935655** (DeathReplay.lua) — `staticAbilityDBByName` mirror built at init by calling `GetAbilityName(castId)` for each Warbuilder entry. New final fallback in `resolveIconForAbility()` checks this map after the existing by-id paths. Closes the tick→cast gap for the 4 Warbuilder-covered abilities (Lotsa Choppin, Tooth of Tzeentch, Tzeentch's Cry, Blade Spin) from FUTURE captures.

**Commit f753c3e** (DeathReplay.lua + DeathReplay_GUI.lua) — exposed `DeathReplay.ResolveIcon` and called it as a render-time fallback in both `OnRowPopulated` (Timeline) and `OnOverviewRowPopulated`. Row dicts now carry `_ability` (raw wstring) alongside `_abilityId` so the resolver gets the same name-key the original capture would have used. Pre-feature deaths and cache-miss captures retroactively get icons on `/reloadui` without rewriting saved data.

Kept the two changes separate so commit B (GUI retroactive resolve) can be reverted independently if the live test misbehaves.

## Test fixture installed (NOT committed)

Slot 13 ("Iamnot") in Plana's `SavedVariables.lua` now has a synthetic death at the top of the deaths list:
- 9 events covering all 6 known missing abilities (incl. cast id 8568 for Tzeentch's Cry as a direct-hit / by-id path validation)
- All events have iconNum unset (nil) so the new render-time resolver gets exercised
- Killing blow: Lotsa Choppin crit at dt=0
- Zone: Pyramid of Settra (zoneId=274, matches slot 13's normal content)
- timestamp=9999 (sentinel — easy to spot)

Expected after `/reloadui` and `/dr`:
- 4 abilities resolve via Warbuilder (Lotsa Choppin → 002635, Tooth of Tzeentch → 005175, Tzeentch's Cry → 005160, Blade Spin → 011052)
- Shock VII and Pilfer VI remain without icons (weapon procs — covered by separate ticket DeathReplay-9sd)
- `/dr debug on` will show `DR_INIT staticAbilityDB built, entries=NNN byName=NNN` confirming the name map populated

Test fixture caveat: maxDeathsStored=5 means any real new capture on Iamnot will eventually evict the synthetic. Leave Iamnot un-killed while testing.

Approach: (1) bisect by temporarily commenting out each <File> entry in DeathReplay.mod one at a time, /reloadui after each, to identify which file the validator dislikes. May ultimately need to enable disk logging via UserSettings.xml <Logging logAllToDisk="true"/> and verify it actually writes to logs/ui_errors.log this time — earlier attempts produced zero log output despite the flag.

title: Resolve weapon-proc ability icons (Shock, Pilfer, etc.)
description:
Weapon procs (item-applied damage from weapon enchants) come through combat log with abilityIds that are not in Warbuilder's career-line database. Likely candidates so far:

- **Shock VII** — seen in death logs, no icon resolved at capture time. Description text *may* be available via PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED if observed; needs verification.
- **Pilfer VI** — same pattern as Shock VII.

These IDs are roman-numeral-suffixed which is the signature pattern for weapon proc tiers (I–VII).

Goal: figure out how to resolve icon/description for weapon-proc abilities. Possibilities:
- `CacheItemIcons(abilityId)` — Obsidian uses this branch in `Castbar.lua:441` when `abilityData.id == 0`, which is the engine's signal for item procs.
- Scrape from `SystemData.Events.PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED` when the proc applies to or comes from the player.
- Static curation list, since the universe of proc tiers (Shock I-VII, Pilfer I-VII, plus other proc families) is bounded.

Related: DeathReplay-3vi (collect missing-icon abilities into SavedVariables side-table) and the Warbuilder integration which covers career abilities but NOT weapon procs.

This ticket is split out of DeathReplay-3vi so career-ability resolution (via Warbuilder) can ship independently.

Hand-curated weapon-proc descriptions for 9 tier-VI procs (Pilfer, Blight, Agony, Acclimate, Judgement, Concussion, Hemorrage, Blades, Burn) wired through DeathReplay.GetAbilityMeta. Icons left as 0 (not provided by user, lookup skips zero icons). New file DeathReplay_WeaponProcs.lua. Non-attack procs (Quickening/Vitalize) excluded since they don't surface in damage HIT events.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text:
## Session 2026-05-28/29 investigation context

Below is everything learned this session that is relevant to resolving Shock VII / Pilfer VI / other weapon-proc icons + descriptions. The chosen approach is **static curation**: user manually extracts in-game tooltip text and provides to agent; agent stores into addon as a name-keyed table; lookup mirrors the Warbuilder bridge pattern from DeathReplay-3vi.

### Engine behaviour for weapon procs

- Captured in real death logs with `abilityId = 0` (not a normal cast id). Verified in Plana's `SavedVariables.lua`: events with `ability = L"Shock VII^n"` carry `abilityId = 0`. Roman-numeral-suffix pattern (Shock I…VII, Pilfer I…VII, etc.) is the weapon-proc tier signature.
- `GetAbilityData(0)` returns nothing useful — confirmed by Obsidian's special-case branch at `Obsidian/Castbar.lua:441` which treats `abilityData.id == 0` as the "item proc" signal and falls back to `CacheItemIcons(abilityId)`.
- The wstring name comes through engine-mangled with `^n` suffix (gender/article marker), same convention as career abilities. Lookup keys MUST include the suffix to match captures: `L"Shock VII^n"`, not `L"Shock VII"`.
- `Tooltips.CreateAbilityTooltip(abilityData, ...)` renders to the global tooltip but does NOT expose description text as data. There is no `GetAbilityTooltip(id) -> string` API. So description text must be CURATED — cannot be fetched at runtime for non-spellbook abilities.

### What Warbuilder does NOT cover

Warbuilder ships only career-line abilities (mastery trees, tactics, morales) across the 24 PvP careers. Confirmed by grep: zero Warbuilder entries match "Shock", "Pilfer", or any high-id weapon-proc range. The DR-3vi name-bridge fix (commit 9935655) explicitly cannot help these.

### What `advancedrenowntrainer` does NOT cover (but the schema is useful)

`advancedrenowntrainer/AdvancedRenownTrainingAbilities.lua` has 102 stat-renown entries (Might I-VII, etc.) but the active-renown rows for Shock/Pilfer/Cleansing Wind/Resolute Defense are **commented out** (lines 446-980). Same naming convention (`"Shock I"` … `"Shock VII"`) — useful as a list of tier names to enumerate. Schema is `{ windowName, id, icon, point, relativePoint, relativeTo, x, y }`. Note: `id` and `icon` fields would have been live cast ids, not proc-tick ids.

### Live runtime hint (not the chosen path, but worth noting)

`SystemData.Events.PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED` event struct carries `{ abilityId, name, iconNum, effectText }` — including a description in `effectText`. If a weapon proc happens to apply a tracked buff to the player (some do), the runtime cache could capture it. But:
1. Most weapon procs are direct damage, not buffs — no PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED fires.
2. Even when it does fire, the description scrape only works for the proc's *target* — useless for "enemy procced on me" which is the death-replay case.

Static curation is the correct path.

### Suggested storage shape (for the upcoming fix)

Mirror Warbuilder integration pattern from DR-3vi. Drop a new Lua table inside `DeathReplay.lua`, name-keyed by the engine-mangled wstring:

```lua
-- Hand-curated weapon-proc metadata. Engine reports these with abilityId=0
-- and no GetAbilityData entry, so we ship the icon + description text inline.
-- Tooltip text was extracted manually in-game by hovering the procced damage
-- in the combat log (or the source weapon's tooltip). Keys must match the
-- engine's wstring exactly, INCLUDING the ^n suffix.
local weaponProcMeta = {
    [L"Shock VII^n"] = {
        icon        = <iconNum>,    -- TBD: extract from in-game tooltip
        description = L"<text>",     -- TBD: paste from in-game tooltip
    },
    [L"Pilfer VI^n"] = {
        icon        = <iconNum>,
        description = L"<text>",
    },
    -- ... Shock I-VI, Pilfer I-V, plus other tiers/families as user provides
}
```

### Integration points

Two hooks needed, both mirror commit 9935655 / 318cf14:

1. **Icon resolution** — extend `resolveIconForAbility(abilityID, abilityName)` in `DeathReplay.lua` (~line 285). After the Warbuilder by-name fallback, add a `weaponProcMeta[abilityName]` check. Returns the icon to bake into the captured event's `iconNum`.

2. **Tooltip description** — extend `DeathReplay.GetAbilityMeta(abilityID, abilityName)` in `DeathReplay.lua` (~line 239). After the Warbuilder by-name fallback, check `weaponProcMeta[abilityName]`. Construct a synthetic meta record — but note: the `castId`/`type`/`buffType`/`line` Warbuilder fields don't apply to procs, so the subtitle path in `OnRowMouseOver` (`DeathReplay_GUI.lua:625-635`) needs to gracefully skip when `meta.line` is nil (it already does — checks `if meta and meta.line`).

   For description: the current code at `DeathReplay_GUI.lua:621` calls `GetAbilityDesc(descId, 40)` which returns L"" for proc abilities. Need to add a meta.description fallback:
   ```lua
   local desc = GetAbilityDesc(descId, 40)
   if (desc == nil or desc == L"") and meta and meta.description then
       desc = meta.description
   end
   ```

### Existing capture sites (no changes needed; just FYI)

- `DeathReplay.lua:419` — `OnCombatEvent` calls `GetAbilityName(abilityID)` for the name string. For proc captures `abilityID=0` and `GetAbilityName(0)` returns L"", so the wstring name must come from somewhere else. **Open question: how does the engine populate `e.ability` for proc HITs?** Check via debug mode — set `/dr debug on` and inspect `DR_HIT aid=0 icon=... name=...` lines from a death where Shock VII fired. If name is L"" at OnCombatEvent time but the saved record has L"Shock VII^n", there's a second resolution path (possibly the combat log text channel) worth understanding before designing the lookup table key.

### Concrete data the user is preparing

Per user: will manually open in-game tooltips for the high-tier weapons whose procs were observed in recent deaths, extract:
- Proc name (must match wstring with `^n` suffix)
- Icon number (visible via `/dr debug on` if the proc is in the runtime iconCache when fired, otherwise needs game-data extraction)
- Description text

Then pass the structured text to a future agent session to populate `weaponProcMeta` and wire the lookup hooks.

### Related work

- DR-3vi (closed-ish, pending live test confirmation): name-bridge for Warbuilder career abilities. Commits 9935655 (capture-time icon) + 318cf14 (hover-time description). Same architectural pattern this ticket should follow.
- Test fixture: Plana `SavedVariables.lua` slot 13 has a synthetic death with Shock VII and Pilfer VI events at `iconNum=nil`. Useful for visual verification once the lookup ships — they will remain icon/description-less until populated.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text:
## Scaffold landed (2026-05-29)

Static-curation plumbing wired across three files:

**New file: `DeathReplay_WeaponProcs.lua`**
- Exposes global `DeathReplay_WeaponProcs.meta` table keyed by engine wstring name (with `^n` suffix).
- Each entry: `{ icon = number, description = wstring }`.
- `DeathReplay_WeaponProcs.Lookup(name)` is the single accessor; `nil`-safe.
- Ships empty — only commented example rows for Shock VII / VI / Pilfer VI so user can copy the shape.

**`DeathReplay.mod`**
- Registered before `DeathReplay.lua` so the global is set up before init runs.

**`DeathReplay.lua`**
- `resolveIconForAbility` (capture path): final fallback now consults `DeathReplay_WeaponProcs.Lookup` after Warbuilder name fallback.
- `DeathReplay.GetAbilityMeta` (GUI path): same final fallback. Returns synthetic `{ icon, description }` only — no `castId`/`line`/`type`/`buffType` — so the GUI subtitle path (which already guards on `meta.line`) skips cleanly.

**`DeathReplay_GUI.lua`**
- After `GetAbilityDesc(descId, 40)` returns empty for proc IDs, falls back to `meta.description`.

## What the user needs to provide

For each weapon proc seen in deaths, three pieces:
1. Engine wstring name (run `/dr debug on` in game and grab from `DR_HIT aid=0 name=...` line — must include `^n` suffix).
2. iconNum (numeric — can be read off the source weapon's enchant tooltip in the game data files, or pulled from a future capture that does resolve via PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED on the procced target).
3. Description text (manually copied from in-game tooltip).

## Not committed

- No commit yet — wait until at least one entry is populated and verified live.
- Test fixture (Plana slot 13) from DR-3vi already has Shock VII and Pilfer VI events with iconNum=nil; once a curated row lands they'll resolve on /reloadui without any new death capture.

## Open question (carried over)

Whether `GetAbilityName(0)` returns the proc's wstring at `OnCombatEvent` time. Saved records DO carry `L"Shock VII^n"` for proc HITs, so SOMETHING populates it — but it's worth verifying with `/dr debug on` once the first curated row is live. If name is empty at capture, the render-time fallback in GUI rows (DeathReplay.ResolveIcon called with `row._ability`) covers already-saved deaths; new captures would need a second source for the name.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text:
## Data populated (2026-05-29)

7 tier-VI procs added from user-supplied tooltip screenshots:

- Pilfer VI, Blight VI, Agony VI, Acclimate VI, Quickening VI, Judgement VI, Vitalize VI

All entries have `icon = 0` (user does not have icon numbers; the lookup skips zero icons so this is a no-op for icon resolution). Descriptions are the full tooltip line ("On Hit: ... ", "On Being Hit: ...", "On Direct Heal: ...") copied verbatim from the source weapon enchant tooltips.

## Coverage gap noted

User noted "different items can have the same procs" — confirmed our keying is correct: lookup is by proc name only, weapon-agnostic.

title: Add ability icon column to damage timeline
description: Add a column to the DeathReplay damage timeline ListBox that renders the icon of the ability associated with each HIT event.
design:
Render-time resolution from already-captured abilityId — no data-model change required.

API path (verified in wsct.lua:543-550, ADDON_UI_GUIDE.md:562):
  local data = GetAbilityData(abilityID) or {}
  if data.iconNum then
      local tex, x, y = GetIconData(data.iconNum)
      if tex and tex ~= "icon000000" then
          DynamicImageSetTexture(rowName .. "Icon", tex, x, y)
      end
  end

Changes:
- DeathReplay_GUI.xml: add a small <DynamicImage> (e.g. 24x24) to the row template at the left of the Name column; shift Name/Amount/Flags anchors right.
- DeathReplay_GUI.lua: in OnRowPopulated (currently lines 103-116), after the existing LabelSetTextColor calls, look up the row's abilityId via Listdata[dataIndex]._abilityId, resolve icon via GetAbilityData/GetIconData, and call DynamicImageSetTexture or hide the image if no icon resolves.
- DeathReplay_GUI.lua: populateTimeline (lines 71-101) needs to add `_abilityId = e.abilityId` to each Listdata entry so OnRowPopulated can access it.
- Width: re-check the Time/Ability/Damage button header widths in the XML so headers still align with shifted columns.

Edge cases:
- abilityId == 0 (melee) → GetAbilityData returns nil → hide the image. Already labelled "Melee" in the name column.
- iconNum exists but GetIconData returns "icon000000" sentinel → hide the image (matches wsct.lua pattern).
- abilityId is captured at OnCombatEvent time; icon lookup is render-time so no SavedVariables migration needed.

Out of scope (separate follow-up issues):
- Attacker name column (requires Combat text-log subscription + regex correlation).
- Attacker class icon (requires PLAYER_TARGET_UPDATED hook + cached career lookup).
acceptance_criteria:
- Damage timeline rows show the ability icon next to the ability name for any HIT with a resolvable abilityId.
- Rows with abilityId=0 (Melee) display no icon (no broken/placeholder texture).
- Rows where GetIconData returns the engine sentinel "icon000000" display no icon.
- Column headers (Time/Ability/Damage) remain visually aligned with their data cells after the layout shift.
- No new errors in chat with /dr debug on.
- Existing sort behavior (Time asc/desc, Damage asc/desc) still works.
close_reason: Ability-icon column shipped on main via merge 84a3a42. Hit-time buff-icon harvest from GetBuffs(SELF), with name fallback for DoT ticks whose abilityId differs from the parent cast. Icons render in both Timeline (per-hit) and Overview (aggregated-by-name) tabs. Documented limit: pure direct-damage abilities (no lingering effect) and Auto-attacks (abilityId=0) never get icons.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text:
Reverted in-progress implementation; bead's "verified API path" turned out wrong for the actual use case. Findings from in-game test:

- GetAbilityData(abilityID) for ENEMY abilityIds (WE Witchbrew/Kiss of Death/Shadow Leap: 9566/1902/8331/9471/9475) returns a non-nil stub but with iconNum=0. Empirically observed via DR_ICON debug print across multiple rows; data=Y for all, icon#=0 for all.
- The wsct.lua:543-550 path I cited as verification only resolves icons for OUTGOING (player-cast) abilities; wsct silently produces no icon for incoming hits and that path was never validated for the incoming-damage use case the bead actually needs.
- ADDON_UI_GUIDE.md:562 only documents GetIconData(iconId) -> texture mapping; it does not promise GetAbilityData covers enemy abilities.
- TextLogGetEntry("Combat", n) returns (timestamp, type, wstring msg) -- no abilityID, no iconNum. Cannot back-fill from chat log.
- Aura/Pure/BuffHead resolve enemy-applied effects via GetBuffs(SELF) -> effect.iconNum, but that only works for ACTIVE debuffs at the moment of query. By the time DeathReplay's window is opened the player is dead and effects are gone.

Path forward (separate plan needed, not in this bead's scope):
- Option A: Capture iconNum at hit-time. Maintain a current-effects table indexed by effectId via PLAYER_EFFECTS_UPDATED; in DeathReplay.OnCombatEvent, try to match abilityId to an active effect and persist effect.iconNum alongside the event in SavedVariables. Risk: the hit's abilityId (cast) often differs from effect.id (DoT/snare applied). Needs probing.
- Option B: Static abilityId -> iconNum lookup for common PvP-relevant career abilities. Maintenance burden, hard to keep current with patches.
- Option C: Drop the icon feature; show attacker career icon instead (already deferred to a follow-up per the original bead's "out of scope" section).

Reopened at P3 pending a real design.

title: Layout polish for replay window — button row + timeline alignment + title bar
description:
v1 window renders functionally but has rough edges:
- Title and NavLabel at top-left look unaligned with the timeline below
- Prev/Next buttons + Dmg/Buffs checkboxes are in a row at y=78 with x=20/100/200/300 fixed offsets — should anchor relative to each other instead of fixed pixels so resizing/scaling stays clean
- Close button at top-right corner is fine but no proper TitleBar (advancedrenowntrainer uses <Window name="$parentTitleBar" inherits="EA_TitleBar_Default"/>)
- Timeline at y=120 leaves visible empty space between the button row and event list; should probably anchor below the last button-row element with a small offset
- Considering an explicit TitleBar child would give a draggable title strip and reclaim the layout pattern used by every other dialog addon
Reference patterns: Interface/AddOns/advancedrenowntrainer/AdvancedRenownTrainingImportDialog.xml lines 16-90 for canonical structure. Also worth re-examining whether 480x420 is the right outer Size now that content is more clearly visible.

comments.author: fetinin
comments.text: Applied layout polish via canonical PotionBar/advancedrenowntrainer pattern: added EA_TitleBar_Default (draggable title strip with auto-positioned title text) and replaced custom close button with EA_Button_DefaultWindowClose (template auto-anchors to titlebar right edge — no more overlap with NavLabel). Button row now chains via sibling anchors: Prev→below NavLabel, Next→Prev.topright+8, FilterDmg→Next.topright+32, FilterBuffs→FilterDmgLabel.topright+12 — kills the hardcoded x=20/100/200/300 pixel offsets. Added explicit Label widgets next to each checkbox for 'damage'/'buffs' text since EA_Button_DefaultCheckBox renders only the box. comments.author: fetinin
comments.text: First attempt broke layout — window stretched across screen and inner widgets reversed. Root causes diagnosed: (1) 'inherits=EA_Window_Default' on the parent Window plus a TitleBar child appears to auto-expand the parent, (2) sibling-relative anchor chaining (topleft -> topright of sibling) reversed button order. Reverted to canonical QueueQueuer/PotionBar pattern: bare Window (no EA_Window_Default inherit), FullResizeImage_MetalFill full-cover bg, TitleBar + EA_Button_DefaultWindowClose still in place (those worked), but all body widgets now anchored absolutely to background.topleft with explicit x/y offsets that account for the ~32px titlebar height (NavLabel y=40, button row y=74, timeline y=116).
